## About me

I am a university researcher and an adjunct professor (docent) at the University of Jyväskylä, working on computational chemistry, machine learning methods and modeling related to catalysis and green chemistry. 
I have a Master's degree in Chemical Technology and a PhD in Computational Chemistry from Aalto University as well as Master's degree from Mathematics from the University of Helsinki. 
My current research focus is in modeling complex oxide-metal interfaces, molecular diffusion in porous materials, hydrogen storage in metal-organic frameworks and electrocatalytic CO2 conversion. 
I work with wide network of experimental collaborators and help them apply my results in their work. 
I also enjoy teaching and regularly lecture to a wide range of audiences, from freshmen to graduate students. 
My publication list can be found [here](publications.qmd).

Below I have collected some notes and tutorials, for those who come after.
